query.esql:
FROM logs-anduril_lattice.entity-*
  | WHERE anduril_lattice.entity.is_live == true
  | WHERE anduril_lattice.entity.indicators.emergency == true
  | STATS entity_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(anduril_lattice.entity.entity_id)

FROM logs-anduril_lattice.entity-*
  | WHERE anduril_lattice.entity.is_live == true
  | WHERE anduril_lattice.entity.indicators.emergency == true
  | STATS entity_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(anduril_lattice.entity.entity_id)

FROM logs-anduril_lattice.entity-*
  | WHERE anduril_lattice.entity.is_live == true
  | WHERE anduril_lattice.entity.ontology.template == "TEMPLATE_TRACK"
  | EVAL quality_tier = CASE(
      anduril_lattice.entity.tracked.track_quality <= 3, "Poor (0-3)",
      anduril_lattice.entity.tracked.track_quality <= 6, "Moderate (4-6)",
      "High (7-9)"
    )
  | STATS entity_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(anduril_lattice.entity.entity_id) BY quality_tier
  | SORT entity_count DESC
